units.source_text: 过了两三天，公子召见惟光，吩咐道：

en.t: Two or three days later, the young lord summoned Koremitsu and instructed him:

units.source_text: “那边有一个人，叫作少纳言乳母的，你去找她，同她详细谈谈。”

en.t: There is someone over there called the Shonagon nurse. Go find her and speak with her in detail.

units.source_text: “我这主子在女人上面的用心，真是无孔不入啊！

en.t: When it comes to women, my master truly misses nothing!

units.source_text: 连这无知无识的黄毛丫头也不肯放过。”

en.t: He will not even let this ignorant little girl pass him by.

units.source_text: 他回想那天傍晚隐约看到的那女孩的模样，心里觉得好笑。

en.t: He recalled the girl's appearance, which he had glimpsed indistinctly that evening, and found it amusing.

units.source_text: 便带了公子的信去见那僧都。

en.t: He then took the young lord's letter and went to see the priest.

units.source_text: 僧都蒙公子特地赐书，心甚感激。

en.t: The priest was deeply grateful to receive a letter sent specially by the young lord.

units.source_text: 惟光便提出要求，和少纳言乳母会了面。

en.t: Koremitsu then made his request and met with the Shonagon nurse.

units.source_text: 他把公子的意思，以及自己所看到的大体情况，详详细细地告诉了这乳母。

en.t: He explained the young lord's intentions and the general circumstances he himself had seen to the nurse in full detail.

units.source_text: 惟光原是个能言善辩之人，这番话说得头头是道。

en.t: Koremitsu was naturally eloquent, and he presented the whole matter clearly and persuasively.

units.source_text: 但是老尼姑那里的人都想：

en.t: But everyone in the old nun's household thought:

units.source_text: 姑娘实在是个毫不懂事的小孩，源氏公子为什么对她用心呢？

en.t: The girl is truly a child who understands nothing at all, so why is Prince Genji taking such an interest in her?

units.source_text: 源氏公子的信写得非常诚恳，其中说道：

en.t: Prince Genji's letter was written with great sincerity, and in it he said:

units.source_text: “她那稚拙的习字，我也想看看。”

en.t: I would like to see her childish, awkward handwriting practice too.

units.source_text: 照例另附一张打成结的小纸，上面写道：

en.t: As usual, a separate little paper folded into a knot was attached, and on it was written:
